items.title: “Every Run Is a Race Run” | Vital's B Practice Podcast - South Korea World Cup
items.description:
After a rough first race of the year, followed by some horrendous travel, it took us an extra week to nail down our guy Dak to podcast. We chatted a good bit about his race weekend in South Korea and how he’s feeling about his program going into the next big block of racing. We also discussed how he rushed to race the Monster Pro Downhill at Mountain Creek last weekend, and how he’s heading to Andorra next week to make his bike stiffer. Plus, all the usual race weekend coverage, including Asa winning his first try in Elites, Aletha having the fastest time of the day, track notes from a wild first-time venue, gripes with the broadcast, Amaury’s what could have been winning run, big names off the pace, new names in juniors, and a bunch of other nonsense. We hope you enjoy. Thanks for listening!

items.title: Greg Minnaar On Why Some Riders NEVER Reach the Top | Just Ride
items.description:
In this episode of Just Ride, Rob Warner and Eliot Jackson sit down with Greg Minnaar to talk about life after racing, building a modern World Cup downhill team, and what it really takes to stay competitive at the highest level of the sport.

From bike setup and rider development to data analysis, team structure, and managing pressure, Greg shares how downhill racing has evolved over the years and how teams are constantly searching for new ways to gain an edge. He also opens up about transitioning from athlete to team director and helping guide the next generation of riders.

The conversation dives deep into World Cup racing, Hardline, the future of downhill MTB, legendary rivalries, and the mindset behind one of the most successful careers the sport has ever seen.

Looking for more Just Ride? Check out all the episodes here: 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpfgeSePLuLxnuzGCXgpiQfMplr9bW-6c

Spotify link: https://open.spotify.com/episode/2lGiOLESWzZKHwYoBrH2y0?si=748fbed21f6446d6

Subscribe to Red Bull Just Ride here:
https://www.youtube.com/@RedBullJustRide?sub_confirmation=1

Join Rob Warner and Eliot Jackson in Just Ride as they delve into an array of cycling adventures. 

Whether on your screens or in your ears, catch them speaking to the biggest names from the world of mountain biking, road cycling, and everything in-between. We've got some incredible guests planned - and we will be bringing you Just Ride from all around the world. 

Come and join the ride!

#mtb #redbull #justride

items.title: Aaron Gwin Was BUILT Different 👀  #mtb
items.description:
In this episode of Just Ride, Rob Warner and Eliot Jackson sit down with Greg Minnaar to talk about life after racing, building a modern World Cup downhill team, and what it really takes to stay competitive at the highest level of the sport.

From bike setup and rider development to data analysis, team structure, and managing pressure, Greg shares how downhill racing has evolved over the years and how teams are constantly searching for new ways to gain an edge. He also opens up about transitioning from athlete to team director and helping guide the next generation of riders.

The conversation dives deep into World Cup racing, Hardline, the future of downhill MTB, legendary rivalries, and the mindset behind one of the most successful careers the sport has ever seen.

items.title: Frameworks 32-Inch-Wheeled DH Bike EXPLAINED
items.description: Neko Mulally is tested out a 32" front wheel on his downhill bike at the  @prodownhillseries  at Mountain Creek. He's running a custom-made FOX 40 fork that's been extended to fit the wheel along with a custom frame to help sort out geometry and axle-to-crown height. His rear wheel remains 27.5".
